name: [🌴] SHARP
desc:
🗡️ SHARP is Roblox’s ultimate high-speed PvP battle experience! Take down opponents, collect coins, and unlock game-changing abilities and perks!

⚔️ Battle other players in intense PvP combat
💰 Defeat enemies, earn coins, and expand your arsenal
🔥 Unlock a wide variety of unique powers and perks
⚡ Powers activate once fully charged — watch for the yellow marker!
🏆 Climb the ranks and prove you’re the sharpest fighter!

🖥️ Play on Desktop, Mobile, Tablet, Xbox & PlayStation 5!
